title: Phase 0.2: the niche doors, About and the Eventbrite comparison stop making money claims the product no longer honors
detail:
The six /for doors still ran the retired ADR-914 rule after ADR-1709 moved selling to Business: six spark cards titled a plan as the reason for the repeat ("A plan is for the second session", "second month", "second night", "second time they show up", "second gift", "the student who drifts") while a free Space runs the email, reminders and nudges they describe (PLAN_STORY.paid); five trustLines promised "You keep 100% of what you bring in." and the nonprofit one "No take-rate on what you raise, ever." with no card processing; the coaches hero said "made perfect"; the nonprofit hero said "Keep all of it"; the event-hosts door put tickets on a free Space in How it works ("your tickets ... Free to start, always", "Sell your tickets") beside a pricing beat that says selling tickets is Business, and its ticket card said "the money is yours"; the teachers pricing intro said Business is for campaigns and "the network rate drops with it". About's principle said "taking money is never behind a plan". The Eventbrite comparison called Frequency "the small, free, repeating room", contradicting /for/event-hosts, promised "0% on your own bookings, always" with no card processing, and its cost row said "Free to join, always".

Fixed as copy only (lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts, lib/page-editor/templates/about.ts, lib/marketing/comparisons.ts): every trustLine now reads "0% on your own audience, plus card processing." (nonprofit: "No network fee on what you raise, plus card processing."); the spark cards name the repeat with no plan attached; every line that sells (coaches sessions, studio memberships, event tickets, community memberships, nonprofit gifts, teacher workshops) names Business or the Non Profit plan beside it; the break-even caption and the cost FAQ say "no network fee ... only card processing" instead of "You keep 100%"; About says selling starts at Business and 0% on your own people plus card processing; the Eventbrite money beat reads PLAN_STORY.spine, .selling and .rate verbatim. No behaviour, checkout or billing change. Not in this row's files and still carrying the About claim: components/page-editor/blocks/dawn.tsx:1411 (a block default with the same "never behind a plan" sentence).
